name: Pine Cliffs Residence, Luxury Collection
positioning: Pine Cliffs Residence, a Luxury Collection Resort, Algarve: two- and three-bedroom apartments in a secluded, pine-shaded corner of the clifftop Pine Cliffs resort above Falesia Beach
best_for: Families and groups who want apartment space with kitchenettes and laundry
Travelers who want a clifftop base above Falesia Beach with resort golf, tennis and spa on hand

facts.text: Pine Cliffs Residence sits at the top of the cliffs at Falesia Beach, with views over the Atlantic Ocean.
Accommodation is in two- and three-bedroom apartments.
The apartments have generous living areas, kitchenettes, laundry facilities and furnished outdoor terraces.
The apartments are decorated with indigenous Algarvian elements.
The apartments are in a secluded area of the resort, surrounded by pine trees and gardens.
Falesia Beach is reached almost exclusively by a lift within the resort that leads to a wooden pathway between the cliffs.
Serenity Spa is on site, and it offers couples experiences.
The resort's 9-hole, par-33 Pine Cliffs Golf Course, designed by Martin Hawtree, runs through a pinewood forest on a cliff-top above the Algarve coast.
The resort offers indoor and outdoor swimming pools and padel and tennis courts.
The Porto Pirata kids' club offers supervised child care for children from 6 months to 8 years old.
In summer, water sports such as jet-ski, kayak and stand up paddle are offered at Falesia Beach.
The concierge team is led by Hugo Viegas, a member of Les Clefs d'Or.

highlights.text: The Residence sits at the top of the cliffs at Falesia Beach, and a lift within the resort leads down to a wooden pathway between the red cliffs.
Two- and three-bedroom apartments come with kitchenettes, laundry facilities and furnished outdoor terraces, set in a secluded area among pine trees and gardens.
Conde Nast Traveler describes the Residences' rooms as having old-school continental elegance, with vast canopy beds and big sitting rooms.
The Porto Pirata kids' club has life-size pirate ships.
On the beach below, guests find the Mare at Pine Cliffs beach bar and sunbeds.

considerations.text: Conde Nast Traveler notes the Residences are set apart on the other side of the golf course from the main hotel hub.
Porto Pirata Kid's Club services are subject to seasonal availability, while the playground is open all year.
Conde Nast Traveler advises booking the smarter resort restaurants at least a couple of days in advance.
